build_yolox_s_model: build a YOLOX-S object detection model with CSPDarknet backbone and YOLOXPAFPN neck for COCO dataset
configure_train_pipeline: configure a YOLOX training pipeline with Mosaic, RandomAffine, MixUp augmentations and YOLOXHSVRandomAug
setup_training_schedule: setup a 300-epoch training schedule with quadratic warmup, cosine annealing, and EMA for YOLOX-S on COCO
configure_optimizer_sgd: configure SGD optimizer with 0.01 base learning rate, 0.9 momentum, and 5e-4 weight decay for YOLOX training
run_coco_evaluation: run COCO bounding box evaluation on YOLOX-S model with SimOTA assigner and NMS post-processing
